title.value: The end of missed diagnoses? How AI is detecting breast cancer cases that physicians overlook

summary.value: "The future of AI in medicine is only at its beginning. The digital revolution is no longer a futuristic dream—it is happening now," write Professor Miri Sklair-Levy and Dr. Debbie Anaby.

The BREACIL Lab participated in the annual Israel Radiological Association Annual Conference (ISRA 2026) October 18–20, 2026 in the Galilee. Three abstracts of ongoing research projects were presented. We look forward to seeing you at the next one!
